edits.why: version statement: the tutorial now targets Matplotlib 3.11

edits.old: Pick the `seaborn` style, which Matplotlib 3.4 ships built in, and draw a line with markers.
edits.new: Pick the `seaborn-v0_8` style, which Matplotlib 3.11 ships built in, and draw a line with markers.
edits.why: the seaborn style was renamed to seaborn-v0_8 and is now versioned

edits.old: Sample four colours from viridis with `matplotlib.cm.get_cmap`.
edits.new: Sample four colours from viridis with `matplotlib.colormaps`.
edits.why: matplotlib.cm.get_cmap was removed in favour of the matplotlib.colormaps registry

edits.old: The tests were run on Matplotlib 3.4,
edits.new: The tests were run on Matplotlib 3.11,
edits.why: version statement: the tests now target Matplotlib 3.11
the b keyword of Axes.grid was replaced by visible

edits.old: Read the RGB buffer size with `tostring_rgb`, which copies the canvas into bytes.
edits.new: Read the RGB buffer size with `buffer_rgba`, which copies the canvas into bytes.
edits.why: FigureCanvas.tostring_rgb was removed in favour of buffer_rgba
